rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that on the afternoon of the 9th 公明党 held an extraordinary national convention and elected 斉藤鉄夫氏 new representative as the successor of 石井啓一代表, the delegates' confidence being given by a show of all hands on the 中央幹事会's recommendation under rule 17-4 ('出席代議員の挙手総員による信任を得て斉藤新代表を選出した').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It reports that in his address to the convention 斉藤代表 recalled that 公明党 would mark sixty years since its founding on the 17th and said the party wanted to make a new start ('あいさつで斉藤代表は').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: It says the convention was held because '石井前代表が党代表の辞任を表明した'.
